findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: instagram_profile, instagram_posts, instagram_post, instagram_comments, instagram_hashtag, youtube_video, youtube_transcript, youtube_comments, tiktok_profile, tiktok_videos, tiktok_video, tiktok_comments · Private data: tiktok_profile · Public sink: instagram_profile, instagram_post, instagram_comments, youtube_video, youtube_search, tiktok_video · Destructive: youtube_transcript.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: instagram_profile, instagram_posts, instagram_post, instagram_comments, instagram_hashtag, youtube_video, youtube_transcript, youtube_comments, tiktok_profile, tiktok_videos, tiktok_video, tiktok_comments · Private data: tiktok_profile · Public sink: instagram_profile, instagram_post, instagram_comments, youtube_video, youtube_search, tiktok_video · Destructive: youtube_transcript

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
